description: Look up the email address(es) of a person or company by name, across ALL accounts, from the emails you've exchanged with them (accents/Greek tonos are ignored). Returns addresses with how often and how recently they appear.

account.description: Which mailbox(es): an alias, an email address, a list of them, or "all". Omit to use ALL connected accounts. No accounts connected yet.

name.description: Name or part of it, e.g. "Μαρία", "Acme", "dhl".

name: find_contact
title: Find a contact's email address
